state.study: Exploratory semantic design probes. Synthetic descriptions only. No rendered images or human outcome measurements. Each question is independent.

density_lookup_v2.instructions: Scenario: Technicians locate one fault code among 50 on a desktop display; entries have short labels and stable IDs. Which conclusion or design direction is best supported for the stated task? Judge the supplied descriptions, not the option letters. Use insufficient evidence when a preference requires missing information; use no relevant difference only when equivalence is established.

criteria.B: Compact indexed rows showing many entries.
criteria.A: Spacious entries showing fewer entries per screen.
criteria.I: The supplied evidence is insufficient to prefer either proposal.
criteria.U: The supplied evidence establishes no relevant difference between the proposals.
